colors.usage: Use Primary (Slate 900) for strong actions and headers. Use Secondary (Violet) for branding moments. Use Accent (Emerald) for success states and 'Buy Now' buttons. Backgrounds should be White or very light Slate.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-11 px-8 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all shadow-lg shadow-primary/20
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/90 h-11 px-8 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all shadow-lg shadow-secondary/20
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/5 h-11 px-8 rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:text-primary hover:bg-slate-100 h-10 px-4 rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors

cards.product: group relative bg-white border border-slate-100 rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:shadow-hover transition-all duration-300
cards.dashboard_stat: bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 shadow-card flex flex-col justify-between h-full

inputs.default: flex h-11 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

customer_landing.hero: Split screen: Left side typography (H1 + CTA), Right side 3D product or high-quality lifestyle image. Or Full-width cinematic background with overlay.
customer_landing.grid: Use 'Tetris' Bento Grid for categories (Grid-cols-12). Mix large 2x2 blocks with 1x1 blocks.

admin_dashboard.structure: Sidebar Layout. Fixed Sidebar (w-64) + Scrollable Main Content.
admin_dashboard.grid: Inverted Pyramid. Top row: 4 Key Metrics (Grid-cols-4). Middle: Main Chart (Col-span-3) + Recent Activity (Col-span-1). Bottom: Detailed Tables.
admin_dashboard.tables: Clean rows, sticky header, pagination at bottom right. No vertical borders.

tech_stack_instructions.frontend: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Shadcn/UI + Framer Motion + Lucide React + Recharts (Admin) + Sonner (Toasts)
tech_stack_instructions.auth: JWT based. Phone/Email login. Use dummy UPI QR code for checkout.
tech_stack_instructions.pdf: Use 'jspdf' and 'jspdf-autotable' for client-side invoice generation.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for text or buttons unless it is a very subtle brand accent.
Do NOT center align the app container. Use 'max-w-7xl mx-auto'.
Ensure all interactive elements have a clear :hover and :focus state.
For the Admin Dashboard, prioritize data density but keep it readable (text-sm for tables).
For the Customer Store, prioritize visual impact (large images, generous white space).
